title: Pseudomonarchia Escalationum
author: Josiah Alan-Lee
edition: Third divergent grimoire / First impression / 16 October 2026 | prose revision, 21 October 2026

handoffs.name: REPETIEL
handoffs.appearance: A mouth at either end of a clean speaking tube.
handoffs.binding: The original number, re-entered by hand.
handoffs.actual_effect: Spent six minutes obtaining facts already attached; ordered the first test again.

handoffs.name: SCRIPTORAX
handoffs.appearance: A cloak made of numbered strips, each cut from a different sleeve.
handoffs.binding: A knowledge-transfer checklist signed by the person being replaced.
handoffs.actual_effect: Converted the operator's warning into a step that the replacement could execute but could not interpret.

handoffs.name: CALMOR
handoffs.appearance: A bell padded on the inside.
handoffs.binding: A revised account without expressions of urgency.
handoffs.actual_effect: Returned the escalation for tone while its technical evidence remained unread.

handoffs.name: REDACTH
handoffs.appearance: A black veil with spaces for initials.
handoffs.binding: A permissible extract, an NDA, and a second request for the omitted context.
handoffs.actual_effect: Removed the shared identifier that showed four failures had one cause.

handoffs.name: CHORAZ
handoffs.appearance: Sixteen small trumpets attached to one empty helmet.
handoffs.actual_effect: Occupied the repairer with status requests until the reserved repair interval closed.

handoffs.name: PROBATOR
handoffs.appearance: A magnifying glass trained upon its own handle.
handoffs.binding: Proof that the proposed action cannot produce any further incident.
handoffs.actual_effect: Required proof obtainable only after the repair; withheld permission to repair.

handoffs.name: PROMISSOR
handoffs.appearance: A ribbon stretched across a hole in the floor.
handoffs.binding: A renewal conversation before the recovery conversation.
handoffs.actual_effect: Exchanged a present defect for a future service commitment.

handoffs.name: CONSENTH
handoffs.appearance: A coat with enough pockets for every unanswered invitation.
handoffs.actual_effect: Mistook consultation for authorization; sent the unapproved work forward as agreed.

handoffs.name: VELAROTH
handoffs.appearance: A sheet folded until only its heading remaineth.
handoffs.binding: A one-line summary without subordinate clauses.
handoffs.actual_effect: Removed the dependency that made the proposed deadline impossible.

handoffs.name: JURISIEL
handoffs.appearance: A door carried sideways through another door.
handoffs.binding: A signed scope statement from the owner whose identity is disputed.
handoffs.actual_effect: Routed a physical failure between service definitions until neither queue retained it.

handoffs.name: MARGOR
handoffs.appearance: A purse drawn on the outside of a sealed purse.
handoffs.binding: Two cost centres agreeing to own one expense.
handoffs.actual_effect: Held the replacement part while departments disputed the charge.

handoffs.name: ABSENTIEL
handoffs.appearance: A row of spare keys cut from the same sheet of paper.
handoffs.binding: A waiver approved by the authority named in the waiver.
handoffs.actual_effect: Presented five dependent routes as five independent safeguards.

handoffs.name: EXCEPTOR
handoffs.appearance: A stamp reading APPROVED upon a form asking for a stamp.
handoffs.binding: Prior authorization to seek emergency authorization.
handoffs.actual_effect: Made the emergency route wait for the same unavailable executive.

handoffs.name: POSTHUM
handoffs.appearance: A small chair wheeled in after the meeting hath ended.
handoffs.binding: Minutes circulated without objection after the deadline.
handoffs.actual_effect: Recorded retrospective support for the repair and prospective blame for its lateness.
